name: discovery-desk
description: A discovery desk panel (/discovery) for UX prototype journeys: walk a journey step by step on iOS or Android, answer its open questions, decisions and ADRs on cards Claude publishes, and hand the answers back to be recorded in the vault first.

folder.title: Desk folder
folder.description: Folder in the project, relative to its root, that holds the walks (pending/, reviewed/) and the walk notes (notes/)

prototypeRoot.title: Prototype root
prototypeRoot.description: Where to look for prototypes: a folder (relative to the project root, or absolute) whose subfolders each hold a prototype.js or a UX Prototype/prototype.js. Empty: the project root

vault.title: Vault name
vault.description: The vault the outcome is recorded in first. Empty: the vault the register names (initiative.vault in prototype.js)

defaultOs.title: Default phone
defaultOs.description: The phone a journey opens on: ios or android

autoOpen.title: Open the desk when Claude publishes a walk
autoOpen.description: Opens the panel on the new walk, unless you are in the middle of another one

handOff.title: Hand submitted walks to Claude
handOff.description: On submit, queue a prompt asking Claude to apply the outcome, the record first (it still asks before writing)

selectableText.title: Selectable text
selectableText.description: On the desktop, draw card and caption text so it can be selected and copied (links then show their address instead of opening)

questionStatuses.title: Question statuses
questionStatuses.description: Comma-separated, the undecided status first and the decided one second

decisionStatuses.title: Decision statuses
decisionStatuses.description: Comma-separated: proposed, decided, rejected (in that order)
